com.vector.cfg.model.mdf

Interface MIObject

  • All Superinterfaces:
    javax.jmi.reflect.IAccessRestricted, com.itiv.generalStore.model.ICheckoutable, IConsistencyObject, aquintos.mm.impl.m2m.rm3.core.IM2MModelElement, IModelObject, com.itiv.generalStore.model.IPersistable, ru.novosoft.mdf.ext.MDFBaseObject, ru.novosoft.mdf.ext.MDFFeatured, ru.novosoft.mdf.ext.MDFObject, javax.jmi.reflect.RefBaseObject, javax.jmi.reflect.RefFeatured, javax.jmi.reflect.RefObject

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
public interface MIObject
extends ru.novosoft.mdf.ext.MDFObject, IModelObject, IConsistencyObject
    The MIObject is the base interface for all AUTOSAR model objects in the DaVinci Configurator data model. It extends MDFObject which is the base interface of all model objects. Your client code shall always use MIObject, when AUTOSAR model objects are used, instead of MDFObject.

    The figure describes the class hierarchy of the MIObject.
